# Fetcher

> Typed HTTP clients, streaming, React hooks, and data viewers.

## Overview

- [Fetcher](/) — Start with one HTTP request, then compose services, streams, and React.

## Start

- [Start with Fetcher](/start/) — Start with one HTTP request, then compose services, streams, and React.
- [Installation and runtime](/start/installation) — Separate application runtime, optional peers, and repository tooling.
- [Your first request](/start/first-request) — Install, request, extract JSON, and handle failure.
- [Choose packages for your task](/start/choose-packages) — Choose packages for your task

## Learn

- [Understand the request lifecycle](/learn/request-lifecycle) — Understand the request lifecycle — Fetcher
- [Build a request and choose its result](/learn/requests-and-results) — Build a request and choose its result — Fetcher
- [Handle errors, timeouts, and cancellation](/learn/interceptors-errors-timeouts) — Handle errors, timeouts, and cancellation — Fetcher
- [Read and close an event stream](/learn/streaming) — Read and close an event stream — Fetcher
- [React data flow](/learn/react-data-flow) — Connect execution, results, and cancellation to component lifetime.

## Recipes

- [Create a Declarative Service](/recipes/declarative-services) — Define, call, and verify a decorator service with explicit request bindings.
- [Generate and Use an OpenAPI Client](/recipes/openapi-client) — Generate a real ItemsApiClient from a complete minimal schema and type-check its consumer.
- [Stream a Chat Completion](/recipes/openai-streaming) — Consume Chat Completions SSE through an application gateway with cancellation and reader cleanup.
- [Send a Wow Command and Read State](/recipes/wow-cqrs) — Configure application aggregate routes, inspect command results, and query or stream snapshot state.
- [Add CoSec Authentication](/recipes/cosec-authentication) — Create a browser authentication session with refresh, token ownership, and cleanup.
- [Share State and Events](/recipes/state-and-events) — Verify local state and ordered events, then opt into browser tab notifications.
- [Build a Data Viewer](/recipes/data-viewer) — Render a paged Viewer with application-owned fetching, cancellation, and recoverable errors.
